title: Agent Office event (one JSON object per line in <session>.events.jsonl)

seq.description: monotonic per session file; viewer orders by this

t.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp of the source record

ses.description: session id = source file basename without .jsonl

room.description: where the actor goes for this event; absent = stay where you are

caption.description: sanitized short text for the speech bubble

ref.description: tool_use_id pairing tool ↔ tool_done/tool_err; agent id for spawn/finish

dur_ms.description: thinking duration (think) or tool wall time (tool_done/tool_err)

meta.description: small, non-sensitive extras: agentType, cwd basename, gitBranch, version, taskId, status
